name: Server Sync
description: Server Sync is a Jellyfin plugin that enables synchronization of media content between multiple Jellyfin servers. Supports parent-child relationships where children sync back to the parent, and peer-to-peer relationships for bi-directional synchronization.
overview: Synchronize media content between Jellyfin servers

## Fixes
- Metadata refresh Phase 3 (heavy fetch by IDs) is now ~10× faster — increased batch size from 50 to 200 IDs per request (4× fewer round-trips) and added 4-way parallelism for chunk fetches within each mapping (was serial). Combined with the existing 4-way mapping parallelism this allows up to 16 concurrent requests against the source.

## Fixes
- Critical fix for people image sync — call UpdateToRepositoryAsync(ImageUpdate) after the SaveImage loop. SaveImage updates the BaseItem's in-memory ImageInfos but the DB write does NOT happen reliably for Person items, so verify's reload-from-DB found zero images and every record that actually needed an image sync failed with local manifest empty, source non-empty.

## Fixes
- PremiereDate (and other date-only fields) no longer trigger perpetual verify failures from timezone artifacts — JSON comparator now treats whole-hour UTC values that resolve to the same calendar date as equal (handles the source serializes midnight-local-TZ as T06:00:00+00:00, local has T00:00:00Z case)
- Source-empty image manifests are no longer treated as a diff — was triggering a no-op apply (nothing to download) followed by a guaranteed verify failure for every person whose source had no images but local did
- Profile image type filtered from the metadata sync source manifest — Jellyfin silently rejects Profile writes on non-Person items (Movies, Series, Episodes), which was causing perpetual verify failures on items whose source DTO included a stray Profile tag
